items.scope: General actual half-open grid1600 whole-child unbuffered positive frozen-parent Jensen integral bound, its exact integer-scale amplitude and e, plus two literal all-zero-child instances with all local geometric payload guards discharged.
mathematical_review: From the actual closed-child residual bound<=b and the frozen ceiling>=S5+2*t5, g_+<=(b-2)*t5 follows. Since0<t5<=T, both g_+/t5 and X=g_+/T lie in[0,b-2], with X<=g_+/t5. This supplies every pointwise Q range guard in the correct direction.

The existing actual32-vertex chord/integral bound gives V*d/(1024*1600)<=integral(g). The geometric upper g<=g_+<=(b-2)*T and positive V,T then prove saved e=d/(1024*1600*T) belongs to[0,b-2]. The range is derived without assuming a desired mean or kernel integral.

The retained ChildQJensen proof uses average(X)>=e, Q increasing, and convex Jensen Q(average X)<=average(Q(X)); hence Q(e)<=average(Q(X)). Actual compact continuity proves positive-kernel integrability; no strict-gate jump or assumed integrability is hidden.

The child endpoint reciprocal amplitude A=(4/T)*prod(1/right_i) is nonnegative and<=the local amplitude. Q>=0 and its monotonicity combine this with the source pointwise minorant. Multiplying normalized Jensen by V*A and using positive finite volume cancels the normalization, yielding integral(kernel)>=V*A*Q(e).

The scale identities agree with the original manuscript: V*A=4*1600*prod(width)/(h5*prod(h_i)), e=d/(1024*h5). The two named instances use their own actual fixed sourcePicks, d=29824/25152, b=4 and 399/100 respectively and T=101/1600.
